description: Final settlement claim for withdrawing the entire Provident Fund balance after leaving service (resignation, retirement). Member should be unemployed for at least 2 months.

fields.name: UAN Number
fields.description: Enter your 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) linked to your PF account. Found on salary slip or EPFO portal.

fields.name: Member Name
fields.description: Your full name exactly as it appears in EPFO records / Aadhaar card.

fields.name: Father's / Husband's Name
fields.description: Mention your father's name or husband's name as per Aadhaar/EPFO records.

fields.name: Date of Birth
fields.description: Your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format. Must match EPFO/Aadhaar.

fields.name: PAN Number
fields.description: Mandatory for claims above Rs. 50,000 to avoid TDS deduction at 30%. Without PAN, TDS is 34.608%.

fields.name: Aadhaar Number
fields.description: Your 12-digit Aadhaar number for identity verification — must be seeded with UAN on EPFO portal.

fields.name: Name & Address of Establishment
fields.description: Name and complete address of the employer you are claiming from.

fields.name: Date of Joining
fields.description: Date when you joined this establishment in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.name: Date of Leaving Service
fields.description: Mention the exact date of your last working day at this establishment.

fields.name: Reason for Leaving
fields.description: Resignation / Retrenchment / Retirement / Health / Migration abroad etc.

fields.name: Full Postal Address
fields.description: Your current residential address including city, state, and PIN code for communication.

fields.name: Bank Account Number
fields.description: Your bank account number where the PF settlement amount will be credited (must be linked to UAN on EPFO portal).

fields.name: IFSC Code
fields.description: IFSC code of your bank branch. Verify from EPFO portal or bank passbook.

fields.name: Mode of Payment
fields.description: Select: ECS (Electronic Clearing System / NEFT). Most settlements are done via NEFT.

fields.name: Advance Stamp Receipt (if cheque payment)
fields.description: If payment is by cheque, affix a revenue stamp on the advance receipt.

fields.name: Employee Signature with Date
fields.description: Sign or affix thumb impression at the bottom of the form with date of filling.
